verdict.rationale: The repo maintains a first-party RELEASE-NOTES.md with detailed, skill-level entries. Examples include the worktree-removal skill now stopping instead of using `--force` (docs-41), the plan-scoped `sdd-workspace` change (docs-42), the review-fix loop resuming the implementer (docs-43), the TDD reference doc rename and rebuild (docs-44), and new harness support (docs-52, docs-53). This lets a developer see what changed in the skills before updating. Missing for 10: evidence tying notes to specific version numbers or tagged releases, and independent corroboration that notes reliably accompany each update.
